posts.name: TheRadGasm
posts.cooked:
I love to play with editing and layout in Microsoft Publisher and Photoshop. This is a supplement I made for one of my favourite games, Sentinels of the Multiverse!

At my house, we each read the backstory of the hero we’re playing as in that game (plus the villain). I’ve been working on this printable book that mirrors the standard rulebooks and has the bios of any promotional alts for heroes and villains that aren’t in print elsewhere. It also has the flavour text for the environments!

It’s still a work in progress, but I’d love some extra eyes on it before it’s printed.

I'll be putting the final version up on BGG, and the best way I've found to print it is to use Staples's online print submission service.

*Massive update for Villains of the Multiverse, Including pullout*

Google Docs - PDF - Advance Release!

...And Im still missing official text on the Enclave and the Capital...

Or, try the new, tablet-friendly version!

posts.name: TheRadGasm
posts.cooked:
Nielzabub:

Why are the pages ordered in a strange order?

Pydro:

The order is there so that you print it out, and make it into a book, putting the pages on top of each other (some upside down), then folding.

Right! So, if you were to submit the file to a document printing service (I use Staples), the sheets will nest perfectly, as-is, into a booklet just like the official ones. If you took the staples out of a comic (or a Sentinels booklet) and separated the leaves, you would find the exact same thing.

You will also notice that the paper size is 11 X 17 ". That's so once you trim it, it is the exact size as the official books! (8.5 X 11 " is too small).

Thanks for checking it out!

She is from the timeline where Finest Legacy is killed. This would have been the scenario if Iron Legacy hadn't got through the Time Cataclysm, or at least I think so. You can find her bio on the app

 

The promo America's Newest Legacy is from before the split, both Legacy and Young Legacy were at the battle against Baron Blade in the original timeline (before Iron Legacy hospitalised both of them creating another timeline split).

If it helps think of Young Legacy as the child who wants to be just like daddy when she grows up, she's happy to stand in his shadow until the time is right for her to step up on her own.

By the time of tactics she's grown a little and doesn't want to be stuck in her father's shadow anymore, so she took a temporary new identity that isn't just Legacy Jnr. from the public point of view so she can stand on her own two feet and not have everyone comparing her to daddy.
